_comment: Copy to fleet.json beside the script on every machine that shares the display, identical on each.
Without this file the script posts its own stats alone, exactly as a single-machine install does.
'name' must match `hostname -s`, and the master must be listed in 'hosts' too.
Give every host an 'ssh' target, the master included. Whoever posts collects from the others,
and during an outage that isn't the master. ssh runs with BatchMode=yes, so keys must work unprompted.
'cmd' is what ssh runs on that host; it defaults to ~/trmnl-claude/run.sh.
The three timing keys are optional. The values below are the defaults, in minutes.
takeover_after_min: how long the master may go quiet before the first successor posts.
successor_stagger_min: how much longer each successor behind it waits for its turn.
stale_after_min: how old a host's numbers may get before it stops counting as reporting.
